mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order (shop_id, status, sku_total, sku_total_price, created_user_id, update_user_id) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{status}, #{skuTotal}, #{skuTotalPrice}, #{createdUserId}, #{updateUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_order WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_order SET id=id WHERE id=#{id} AND shop_id=#{shopId} AND created_user_id=#{userId} AND status='WAIT_PAY'
UPDATE tb_order SET id=id WHERE id=#{id} AND shop_id=#{shopId} AND created_user_id=#{userId} AND status!='COMPLETED'
UPDATE tb_order SET status=#{after},update_user_id=#{userId},updated_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id=#{id} AND shop_id=#{shopId} AND created_user_id=#{userId} AND status=#{before}
